spans.s: Not one; more than one, many; अनेक- पितृकाणां तु पितृतो भागकल्पना

Separated; divided; oft. in comp.; ˚आकार having many shapes or forms; diverse, multiform; ˚कालम् -वारम् several times, many a time and oft.; ˚भार्य having more wives than one. -Comp. -अक्षर, -अच् a. having more than one vowel or syllable; polysyllabic. -अग्र a.
not concentrated or fixed on one object.
Agitated. perplexed; स त्वनेकाग्रहृदयो द्वास्थं प्रत्यर्च्य तं जनम्
[न. ब] not alone so as to exclude all others, uncertain, doubtful, variable; स्यादित्यव्ययमनेकान्तवाचकम्
an unessential part, as the several anubandhas. ˚वादः scepticism. ˚वादिन् m. a sceptic, a Jaina or an Arhat of the Jainas. -अर्थ a.
having many (more than one) meanings, homonymous; as the words गो, अमृत, अक्ष &c.; ˚त्वम् Capacity to express more senses than one; अनेकार्थत्वमन्याय्यम् ŚB. on
having the sense of word अनेक.
having many objects or purposes. (-र्थः) multiplicity of objects, topics &c. -अल् a. having more than one अल् (letter)

. -आश्रय, -आश्रित a. (in Vais. Phil.) dwelling or abiding in more than one (such as संयोग, सामान्य); एते$नेकाश्रिता गुणाः Bhāsā. P.; dependence upon more than one. -कृत् m. 'doing much', N. of Śiva. -गुण a. of many kinds, manifold, diverse; विगणय्य कारणमनेकगुणम्

. -गोत्र a. belonging to two families (such as a boy when adopted)i. e. that of his own, and that of his adoptive father. -चर a. gregarious. -चित्त a. not of one mind, fickle-minded; कच्चिन्नानेकचित्तानां तेषां त्वं वशमागतः
. ˚मन्त्रः not following the counsels of one;
. -ज a. born more than once. (-जः) a bird (गर्भाण्डाभ्यां जातत्वात्). -पः an elephant (so called because he drinks with his trunk and mouth); cf. द्विप; वन्येतरानेकपदर्शनेन
पद a. multi-numbered; having many component members (as in a Bahuvrīhi compound). e. g. बृहद् अस्य रथन्तरसाम
. -भार्य a. Having more wives than one. -मुख a. (खी f.) a.
scattered, dispersed, going in various directions, taking to various ways; (बलानि) जगाहिरे$नेकमुखानि मार्गान्
. -मूर्तिः 'having many forms', N. of Viṣṇu who assumed various forms to deliver the earth from calamities. -युद्धविजयिन्, -विजयिन् a. victorious in many battles;
fickle, changeable, of a varying nature; वेश्याङ्गनेव नृपनीतिरनेकरूपा

. (-पः) epithet of the Supreme Being. -लोचनः N. of Śiva; also of Indra, and of the Supreme Being, he being said to be सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् &c. -वचनम् the plural number; dual also.-वर्ण a. involving more than one (unknown) quantity (the unknown quantities x. y. z. &c. being represented in Sanskrit by colours नील, काल &c.); ˚समीकरणम् simultaneous equation; ˚गुणनम्, ˚व्यवकलनम्, ˚हारः multiplication, subtraction or division of unknown quantities.-विध a. various, different. -शफ a. cloven-hoofed.-शब्द a. synonymous. -साधारण a. common to many, the common property of many persons
अनेकधा [anēkadhā], ind. In various ways, variously; जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा
Several or many times, frequently; अनेकशो निर्जितराजकस्त्वम्
In large numbers or quantities; पुत्रा अनेकशो मृता दाराश्च
अनेकाकिन् [anēkākin], a. Not alone, accompanied by.
अनेकीकृ [anēkīkṛ], or भू To make or be manifold; to divide or be divided into.
अनेजत् [anējat], a. [न एजत्] Not moving, immovable; of the same form, epithet of Brahman or the Supreme Soul (सर्वदैकरूपं ब्रह्म) अनेजदेकं मनसो जवीयः Īs.
अनेडः [anēḍḥ], A foolish or stupid person, dolt, fool. -Comp. -मूक a.
deaf and dumb; ˚मूकताद्यैश्च द्यतु दोषैरसंमतान् K.
Not to be blamed; praiseworthy, chief (प्रशस्त, प्रधान).
अनेन [anēna], a. Sinless, faultless (Sāy.); without a variegated set (of horses); अनेनो वो मरुतो यामो अस्तु
अनेनः [anēnḥ], 'One who has no superior', a sovereign or paramount lord.
अनेनस् [anēnas], a. Sinless, blameless; not liable to error.
अनेव [anēva], ind. Otherwise; एवानेवाव सा गरत्
अनेहस् [anēhas], a. [न हन्यते, हन्-असि, धातोः एहादेशः नञि हन् एह च
] (lit.) Not killed or destroyed or obstructed; Ved. without a rival, incomparable, unattainable, inaccessible; unobstructed, not liable to be hurt or injured; शंभुवं मन्त्रं देवा अनेहसम् Rv.
;6.5.3.-m. (हा-हसौ &c.) Time (not being liable to be destroyed). cf. तस्मादनेहसं कंचित्प्रतीक्षस्व महाभुज Śiva.
also 5.11,59. कुसुमबाणसखेन सुखासितं विपिनमापि न मानमनेहसा Rām.
